verified.profile: docs: https://www.browserbase.com/blog/introducing-authenticated-fetch -- also checked live by hand on 2026-10-29 (a cookie saved in a persisting session came back from a fetch naming its Context); tests/providers/test_browserbase_extract.py::test_live_a_cookie_saved_in_a_session_rides_along_on_a_fetch_naming_its_context automates that check and has not run yet

allowRedirects.note: Boolean, off by default; with it off a redirect comes back as the target's own status_code.

proxies.note: Boolean; routes the fetch through Browserbase's proxies.
